text:
Claire: Final preflight for Wed 11:30am PT webinar on 'Serving at Scale'. Need confirmation on reg page fields, Zoom + backup recording, upload naming, and the post-event email schedule.

Omar: I'll handle Zoom and uploads. Checklist: cloud recording (active speaker + shared screen), enable audio transcript (VTT), record local OBS backup, add co-host Nina, keep 'Only authenticated users' OFF. Post-event I'll download cloud MP4 + VTT and upload to S3.

Nina: I'll own the registration page and tracking. Required fields: email, company, job_title, consent checkbox. Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_medium. HubSpot form GUID = will paste after staging. Tagging event_key: svserve_0825. Also want a calendar confirmation variant with prep doc vs one with a quick checklist.

Diego: Editing + social here. Deliverables: 1x 90s highlight, 3x 30s social cuts (16:9 + 9:16), SRT captions, raw transcript .txt. Request naming: SS0825_raw_cloud.mp4, SS0825_transcript.txt, SS0825_clip01_30s.mp4. Need raw access within 2 hours.

Omar: Upload flow (post-event): 1) Download cloud MP4 + VTT 2) Copy local OBS MP4 3) Upload both to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-08-25-serving-scale/raw/ 4) Set ACL marketing-editors and create a Drive editor folder. I'll generate a 14-day signed replay URL for the 1h email.

Omar: Quick CLI for manual upload if needed:
```
aws s3 cp "SS0825_raw_cloud.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-08-25-serving-scale/raw/SS0825_raw_cloud.mp4" --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp "SS0825_raw_local.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-08-25-serving-scale/raw/SS0825_raw_local.mp4"
aws s3 cp "SS0825_transcript.vtt" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-08-25-serving-scale/raw/SS0825_transcript.vtt"
```

OpsBot: Reminder: S3 lifecycle should keep raw for 90 days; don't expire earlier.

Nina: HubSpot mapping draft for ops:
- hs_form_guid: c9b4a7d2
- fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, job_title, consent, utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_medium]
- lead_routing: webhook -> https://hooks.redwood-internal/marketing/webinar-leads
- contact_tag: svserve_0825
I will paste exact GUID after publishing to staging.

Diego: For clips, please include timestamps.txt with ranges and speaker name hints. I'll convert VTT -> SRT and burn captions for socials. Prefer local OBS for camera cuts if file exists.

Claire: Proposed post-event cadence:
- 1h after: private replay email (short summary + 14-day signed link + scheduler CTA)
- 18h after: highlights email with 3 clips + one benchmark stat as hook
- 48h after: full edited recording + transcript + blog summary
- 5 days: asset library complete, SDR handoff with MQL list (criteria: company size >50, job_title in ["Engineering","Platform"]).

Omar: I'll post the Drive link and S3 keys within 2 hours of end. If cloud recording fails, use local OBS file and upload that; name it SS0825_raw_local.mp4.

Nina: I'll A/B test confirmation email variants (prep doc vs checklist) and report opens/CTRs. Also will ensure utm params are appended to the replay link.

Diego: Copy suggestion for 1h replay email: "Thanks for joining our Serving at Scale session. Watch the replay and grab the clips here. Want to see this on your workload? Book a 15-min demo." Keep it punchy.

Claire: Owners recap: Reg page & tracking = Nina; Zoom host + raw uploads = Omar; Clips & edits = Diego; Replay cadence + emails = Claire. Deadline: raw files uploaded and Drive link posted within 120 minutes; first cut of clips in 48 hours.

Omar: Adding co-host Nina and confirming transcript language = English (US). Turning off meeting authentication now.

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Omar at 11:31 AM PT. Cloud recording enabled.

Claire: I'll run a registration smoke test at 4pm PT and post results. If anyone sees a problem with HubSpot mapping, @Nina ping me. Thanks all :tada:

ZoomBot: Recording ended at 12:37 PM PT. Cloud recording available: https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_SS0825 (access restricted).
